description: This file is a PHP script that generates an HTML page for a web-based wizard step for changing passwords in a gateway configuration interface. It includes form validation, dynamic password field toggling, and AJAX calls for setting the configuration.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the session's login user.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to update the configuration with a new password.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates configuration update via AJAX.
